articles.title: Incêndio no Distrito Industrial 2: Justiça suspende atividades | G1
articles.standfirst: Decisão liminar atende parcialmente a pedido do MPAM e prevê multa diária de R$ 100 mil em caso de descumprimento. Incêndio começou em 6 de outubro e atingiu mais de 15 mil m².
articles.summary: A Justiça suspendeu licenças ambientais no Distrito Industrial 2 após incêndio de grandes proporções e suspeitas de irregularidades apontadas pelo MPAM em Manaus.
articles.body:
A Justiça do Amazonas determinou a suspensão imediata das licenças ambientais e a paralisação das atividades operacionais e comerciais em uma área atingida por um incêndio de grandes proporções no Distrito Industrial 2 , no início de outubro, em Manaus .

A decisão atende parcialmente a um pedido do Ministério Público do Amazonas (MPAM), que ajuizou uma ação civil pública para apurar possíveis irregularidades ambientais no local.

A liminar foi concedida pela Vara Especializada do Meio Ambiente da Comarca de Manaus. Em caso de descumprimento da ordem de paralisação, foi estabelecida multa diária de R$ 100 mil, destinada a programas ambientais, sem prejuízo de eventual responsabilização criminal.

O incêndio começou em 6 de outubro de 2026 e atingiu uma área superior a 15 mil metros quadrados, segundo informações citadas na decisão. O fogo provocou uma densa nuvem de fumaça, com impactos na qualidade do ar e riscos à saúde pública.

MP aponta suspeita de irregularidades ambientais

A ação do MPAM foi baseada em informações reunidas durante a apuração do caso. Segundo o órgão, dados preliminares do Instituto de Proteção Ambiental do Amazonas (Ipaam) indicaram que a licença concedida para o empreendimento autorizava apenas o armazenamento de resíduos inertes.

No entanto, havia suspeita de que o local também armazenava materiais inflamáveis ou combustíveis, o que motivou o pedido de suspensão das autorizações e das atividades.

Na decisão, a Justiça considerou o cenário de intensa fumaça em Manaus, os riscos à saúde pública, a necessidade de evacuação de trabalhadores da região e a atuação contínua do Corpo de Bombeiros no combate ao incêndio.

O g1 questionou o posicionamento dos proprietários, mas até a atualização mais recente desta reportagem não obteve resposta.

Incêndio atinge vegetação em Manaus. — Foto: William Duarte/Rede Amazônica

A suspensão das atividades não se aplica às ações emergenciais necessárias para reduzir os riscos no local. Segundo a decisão, devem continuar os trabalhos de combate a focos remanescentes, rescaldo, controle de poluentes e demais medidas determinadas pelo Corpo de Bombeiros e pelo Ipaam.

O instituto ambiental também deverá fiscalizar o cumprimento da ordem judicial e registrar a suspensão das licenças em seus sistemas.

A decisão determina ainda que a 50ª Promotoria de Justiça Especializada na Proteção do Meio Ambiente e Patrimônio Histórico (Prodemaph), sob responsabilidade da promotora Lílian Maria Pires Stone, dê continuidade à investigação e obtenha os documentos e as informações necessários para a instrução do processo.

articles.title: On lines of US, India ‘developing integrated defence logistics system for tri services’ that will support planned theatre commands
articles.summary: NEW DELHI: In a move to integrate defence logistics infrastructure that will help in seamless coordination among three services, especially during
articles.body: NEW DELHI: In a move to integrate defence logistics infrastructure that will help in seamless coordination among three services, especially during conflicts, the Union govt is developing an integrated logistics structure on the lines of the US to support its planned theatre commands.The details of the project, being spearheaded by the department of military affairs (DMA), have been explained in a letter that Rear Admiral Kunal Singh Rajkumar, a joint secretary (navy and defence staff) in DMA, wrote to Rajya Sabha MP Ajeet Madhavrao Gopchade in response to his missive to PM Narendra Modi in which the latter gave suggestions for “examining a unified defence logistics and fuel management framework on the lines of the US Defence Logistics Agency”.In his letter, MP Gopchade has drawn attention to the functioning of US DLA, which serves as a single centralised combat logistics support agency for the entire US department of defence. US DLA manages fuel supply, military procurement, spare parts, logistics AI systems, defence standardisation, petroleum quality assurance, warehousing, technical support, and global supply-chain management under an integrated tri-service structure. He also told PM that at present, logistics management in India is largely distributed across multiple service-specific structures such as Army Service Corps, Army Ordnance Corps, EME, Naval logistics branches, Air Force maintenance systems, fuel depots and various procurement and inventory mechanisms.Talking to TOI, Gopchade said DMA has informed him that “all best practices relevant in India’s context are being incorporated in creation of an integrated logistics structure to support planned theatre commands”. To give proper shape to the proposal, he has been told that “joint operations logistics committee (JOLC), joint services study group (JSSGs), joint working groups (JWGs) and inter-service maintenance working groups (IMWGs) have been constituted at appropriate levels to integrate logistics process and procedures among the services.”The MP further told TOI DMA has informed him “tri-services logistics management application is also under development to provide real time inter-service inventory visibility and to integrate service specific enterprise resource planning software”. He was also briefed in the letter that “work on the National Defence Codification System is also under way and that joint logistics node and subsequently joint ammunition depots, air stores supply parks and material organisations are being planned pan-India”.The PM Gati Shakti defence portal is also under development to align with National Logistics Policy and Unified Logistics Interface Platform for providing a defence-equivalent ‘joint logistics interface’ across three services and theatre boundaries. Furthermore, emerging AI and machine learning technologies are being incorporated for logistic optimisation. A joint logistics integration, akin to US DLA, is a strategic imperative for the country and its realisation is a prime priority for the defence ministry, he was told.In his letter to the PM, MP Gopchade had suggested a slew of reforms such as setting up of a unified defence fuel management system, introduction of a secure military fuel card system, an AI-enabled predictive logistics and maintenance and integrated petroleum quality assurance network.

articles.title: Tony Hawk founded a nonprofit in 2002 to expand access to free public skateparks; it has since helped fund nearly 700 parks across all 50 US states
articles.summary: For young skateboarders, finding a safe, legal place to practise is not always easy.
articles.body: For young skateboarders, finding a safe, legal place to practise is not always easy. Since 2002, a nonprofit founded by professional skateboarder Tony Hawk has helped communities develop public skateparks, particularly in areas with limited recreational facilities. Formerly known as the Tony Hawk Foundation, the organisation became The Skatepark Project in 2020 to put its mission at the centre of its identity. It provides grants, technical assistance and other resources to communities seeking to create free public skating spaces. The organisation says it has helped fund nearly 700 skateparks across all 50 US states. A February 2026 Los Angeles City Council report separately documents its involvement in a skateboarding facility at the West Los Angeles Municipal Complex. Its work includes permanent community parks and temporary facilities developed with municipal authorities. Examples from Augusta, Kansas, and Los Angeles show how nonprofit support can help expand access to public recreation.The Skatepark Project: how Tony Hawk’s foundation began in 2002Hawk established the nonprofit to address the shortage of public places where young people could skateboard legally. According to The Skatepark Project’s account, Hawk used the $125,000 he won on Who Wants to Be a Millionaire in 2001 to help launch the organisation. It was formally founded in 2002 as the Tony Hawk Foundation. The foundation focused on helping communities secure funding and other resources for public skateparks, especially in underserved areas. Rather than limiting its work to financial assistance, it developed a community-oriented approach involving local advocates, public authorities and skatepark users.In 2020, the foundation adopted the name The Skatepark Project. A 2020 announcement about the rebranding reported that the organisation had helped fund more than 600 public skateparks across all 50 states. Its current programmes include grants of up to $25,000 for eligible projects, as well as technical assistance and support for youth activities. The organisation’s grant guidelines specify that projects must provide permanent, public concrete skateparks in underserved communities, remain free to use and involve local users in planning, fundraising and design. The organisation’s grant guidelines also set requirements for community support and project funding.Free skateparks in underserved communities: how grants and local funding workThe emphasis on free access is central to the organisation’s mission. A public skatepark does not require users to pay an entry fee or purchase a membership, although skaters may still need their own equipment. The Skatepark Project’s support is intended to help communities create facilities where young people can participate without the cost of private recreational venues. One of its regional initiatives is Built to Play, a partnership with the Ralph C. Wilson, Jr. Foundation. The Built to Play initiative, a partnership with the Ralph C. Wilson, Jr. Foundation, aimed to support up to 20 public skateparks across 16 counties in Southeast Michigan and Western New York. A separate example comes from Augusta, Kansas. In an announcement about a $15,000 grant from The Skatepark Project, the city said the funding would help address potential construction-cost increases for its community skatepark. The city also described plans to pursue additional funding and continue local fundraising.The Augusta project subsequently opened to the public on 5 November 2023, according to the city’s skatepark opening announcement. The example illustrates the wider role of municipal planning and community investment in establishing public recreational facilities. The Built to Play initiative and Augusta’s grant are separate examples of the organisation’s work, rather than parts of the same programme. The organisation’s reported national reach should be distinguished from estimates of park usage. Published figures for annual visits vary, and the available material does not establish whether they use comparable dates or counting methods. These estimates should therefore not be presented as a verified count of unique visitors.Los Angeles skate plaza: a $70,000 donation accepted in 2026The organisation’s work also includes temporary facilities developed with local authorities. In Los Angeles, the City Council considered a donation valued at approximately $70,000 for skateboarding features at the West Los Angeles Municipal Complex. The city’s official council record confirms that the council adopted the Government Operations Committee report on 3 February 2026, with all recorded votes in favour. The donation comprised labour, materials and equipment for four skate obstacles, handrails, ledges, a wedge spine, signage and replicas of courthouse monuments.Under the proposal, the Skatepark Project would oversee the design and construction with professional builders and cover the associated costs. The improvements were intended to provide a temporary skating facility while the complex remained subject to redevelopment plans. A local report described new features and murals being unveiled at the site on 3 February 2026, the same day the City Council adopted the committee report. The Los Angeles example shows that the organisation’s role can extend beyond conventional grants. It can contribute equipment, construction resources and project oversight to help create skating opportunities at existing public sites.Across its programmes, The Skatepark Project combines grant funding, technical assistance and partnerships with communities and public agencies. Its reported national reach provides a measure of the scale of its work, while local examples show how individual facilities depend on planning, funding and construction. The number of parks alone cannot establish how much access has improved in every community, but the projects demonstrate a sustained effort to make public skateboarding spaces available without entry fees.You use AI every day. articles.title: Takaichi says chores, makeup add hours to her workday, sparks debate on gender roles
articles.summary: TOKYO: Japanese PM Sanae Takaichi’s comments that she works longer than her male predecessors because of household chores and makeup have sparked debate
articles.body: TOKYO: Japanese PM Sanae Takaichi’s comments that she works longer than her male predecessors because of household chores and makeup have sparked debate over gender roles and work-life balance in Japan.Addressing parliament Wednesday, Takaichi described the additional demands she faces as a woman. “In the morning, I take a bath, fix breakfast and do the dishes, then apply makeup,” she said. “Doing these things, I feel I’m spending three or four more hours than male prime ministers.”She said aides took time to realise she needed extra time to apply makeup and prepare for television appearances. Her remarks drew criticism for reinforcing traditional gender roles and normalising excessive working hours. Govt figures show women spend nearly five hours daily on housework, against about 40 minutes for an average man.Takaichi, who took office last year, has said she sleeps between zero and three hours a night because of homemaking responsibilities and her official workload. Critics said she was setting a poor example on work-life balance and gender equality.Fumitake Fujita, a senior official of junior coalition partner Japan Innovation Party, raised the issue of PM’s schedule Wednesday, suggesting that hours-long parliamentary sessions, which ministers attend almost daily, be reduced. Citing NXJI Research, he said Japan’s PM attended parliamentary sessions on 72 days in 2022, compared with 50 in Britain and 13 in Germany.Takaichi said she routinely takes home documents despite difficulty managing her schedule. “I do enjoy reading them late at night,” she said. “Honestly, I feel it is not easy to squeeze out time to sit down and think about the future direction of Japan or have a grand vision.”You use AI every day. articles.title: A 7am email to employer, ‘I love you’ on clothes and a chilling ‘leaving this world’ note on wife’s birthday: What preceded Malayali techie couple’s deaths in Gurgaon flat
articles.summary: GURGAON: An email sent to his employer at around 7am, saying “we are leaving this world”, set off a chain of events that led to the discovery of an IT
articles.body: GURGAON: An email sent to his employer at around 7am, saying “we are leaving this world”, set off a chain of events that led to the discovery of an IT professional and his wife dead in their Gurgaon apartment on Wednesday.The techie had also shared the phone numbers of his parents and landlord, asking the company to inform them.When the landlord reached the flat in Tower 7 of M3M Marina, he found Mohammad Aslam (30) hanging and his wife, Farhana, who was about to turn 28, lying on the floor with an injury mark on her neck. He alerted Badshapur police station.Inside the flat, police found a note bearing the words “We are leaving this world”. The words “I love you” had also been scribbled on Farhana's clothes. Investigators are examining the messages and other material recovered from the apartment as they piece together what led to the couple’s deaths.Police suspect Aslam killed Farhana before dying by suicide, but said the sequence of events and the cause of death had not yet been established. A murder case was registered under Section 103(1) of the Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita (BNS).The couple’s families, based in Kerala, have been left struggling to understand what happened. Relatives said they knew of no marital discord and described the couple as being close to each other. They said Aslam had been undergoing treatment for depression for around a year and a half.“The couple shared a really close bond. Both were happy with each other and had no marital discord. There was no issue with the family either. But hearing this has left both families in shock,” said Faisal, Farhana’s brother.Moved to Gurgaon three months agoThe couple had relocated to Gurgaon from Bengaluru around three months ago. Aslam, a native of Kozhikode, had joined an Indonesia-based IT company with an office in Sector 58. Farhana, who hailed from Malappuram, worked from home for an IT firm based in Bengaluru.They married in 2023 and spent around two years in Bengaluru before moving to Gurgaon.Aslam graduated in electrical and electronics engineering from NIT Calicut in 2018 and completed his MBA from IIM Indore in 2020. Farhana had completed her BTech from MES College of Engineering in Kuttippuram, Kerala.Family members said Aslam had been taking medication and undergoing therapy for depression for around 18 months. They said neither he nor Farhana had discussed any problems that might have suggested they were going through a difficult period.Faisal said relatives suspected work pressure could have contributed to the tragedy, although they had no confirmation of what the couple had been experiencing.“We used to go on trips together, and I connected very well with my brother-in-law. We suspect that work pressure in the IT sector may have led to the incident. They never discussed anything that suggested they were suffering or going through something so bad. Work pressure is the only reason we suspect, but only God and the two of them knew what was happening,” he said.Another relative, Abdul Azeez, said the family believed the incident may have occurred around midnight on Wednesday. Farhana was due to celebrate her birthday that day.“Her parents have been left shattered. We just want to take their bodies home,” he said.Email prompted colleagues to contact landlordAfter Aslam’s email arrived around 7am on Wednesday, his colleagues contacted the landlord using the details provided. The landlord went to the apartment, found the couple dead and alerted the police.An emergency response vehicle reached the spot around 8am, followed by a larger police team. An officer said the flat’s door was not bolted.Police recovered three laptops, two mobile phones, a rope, the note, a diary, scissors and a pen drive from the apartment. The electronic devices were seized for forensic analysis. Police said the note contained no allegations against anyone.Both bodies were shifted to a mortuary and identified by family members on Friday. Autopsies were yet to be conducted.“The cause of death will be established only after the autopsy report. It is suspected that the husband killed his wife and later died by suicide after sending an email to his office,” the officer said.Police are examining the evidence to establish the circumstances and sequence of the deaths.You Can Also Check: Gold Rate in Gurgaon | Silver Rate in Gurgaon | Bank Holidays in Gurgaon | Public Holidays in Gurgaon | Gurgaon AQI | Weather in Gurgaon | Petrol Price in Gurgaon | Diesel Price in Gurgaon | CNG Price in Gurgaon | LPG Price in GurgaonStay updated with the latest Gurgaon news. articles.title: BJP veteran LK Advani in ICU under medical observation after chest infection
articles.summary: NEW DELHI: Veteran BJP leader Lal Krishna Advani, 98, was admitted to Indraprastha Apollo Hospital in Delhi on Friday evening with pulmonary issues.
articles.body: NEW DELHI: Veteran BJP leader Lal Krishna Advani, 98, was admitted to Indraprastha Apollo Hospital in Delhi on Friday evening with pulmonary issues. His comdition is now stable.Union minister JP Nadda visited the hospital to meet Advani."LK Advani has been admitted to Apollo Hospitals with a chest infection. He is currently in the ICU under the care of Dr Vinit Suri, Senior Consultant – Neurology. His condition is stable, and he remains under close medical observation," Indraprastha Apollo Hospitals said in a statement.Advani served as BJP president multiple times and was deputy prime minister from 2002 to 2004.He played a key role in the party's rise as a major national force.Get the latest India News and Live updates. articles.title: 5 workers killed, 5 injured in explosion at chemical unit in Gujarat's Bharuch
articles.summary: BHARUCH: At least five workers were killed and five others injured in an explosion at a pharmaceuticals factory in Sayakha GIDC area in Gujarat’s Bharuch,
articles.body: BHARUCH: At least five workers were killed and five others injured in an explosion at a pharmaceuticals factory in Sayakha GIDC area in Gujarat’s Bharuch, police said.The blast occurred around 10 pm on Friday during a hydrogenation process and triggered a leak of methylene dichloride (MDC) gas, officials said.Bharuch Sub-Divisional Magistrate Manisha Manani said SynZeal Pharmachem, which was set up in Saykha a year ago, manufactures pharmaceutical intermediates.The explosion, suspected to have occurred during the hydrogenation process, was powerful enough to rip apart the reactor tank, scattering machinery parts across the premises, she said.Superintendent of Police Akshyaraj Makwana said that five people died in the blast, while five others sustained injuries.The deceased were identified as Jaydeep Maheshbhai Patel and Bhavik Dilipkumar Vasava, both from Amod; Vrund Talaviya from Talala in Gir Somnath district; and Uttar Pradesh natives Aniket Harilal Gautam and Arjunkumar Ramsingh Gautam, he said.The injured workers were identified as Pavankumar Ramsingh Gautam, Mausamkumar Ramsevak Yadav, Shivdayal Ramavatar Yadav, Pratik Pravin Prajapati and Priyanshu Bahadurlal. The workers, who hail from Bihar and Uttar Pradesh, are undergoing treatment, Makwana said.An official of the Directorate of Industrial Safety and Health (DISH) said the blast during the hydrogenation process triggered a leak of methylene dichloride (MDC) gas.Officials from the Gujarat Pollution Control Board, DISH and the police reached the site. articles.title: Deva, composer whose music announced Rajinikanth's stardom, dies at 75 in Chennai
articles.summary: CHENNAI: Deva, the music director whose \"Superstar\" title-card music has announced every Rajinikanth film since 1992, including the latest, Jailer 2, died
articles.body: CHENNAI: Deva, the music director whose "Superstar" title-card music has announced every Rajinikanth film since 1992, including the latest, Jailer 2, died in Chennai on Saturday. He was 75.He complained of chest pain on Saturday morning and was taken to Surya Hospital. He died despite efforts to resuscitate him, doctors said.The godfather of Gaana, Deva was a music director, lyricist and singer who took the street music of Chennai into mainstream cinema. He wrote and sang many of his own gaana numbers and was a rage through the 1990s. The songs he made popular are now sung even at international film events.At a time when Ilaiyaraaja dominated Tamil cinema and AR Rahman was ushering in a musical revolution, Deva carved out his own identity by speaking the language of the common man. Rather than competing with the two musical stalwarts, he built his reputation on simple, catchy tunes, familiar rhythms and colloquial expressions that resonated with audiences.Affectionately known as Thenisai Thendral, he became one of the most sought-after composers of the 1990s.For Rajinikanth, he created the vibe for the star's introductory songs, including those in Annamalai and Baashha. The Baashha theme became synonymous with Rajinikanth's screen persona, while Naan Autokaaran became an anthem for autorickshaw drivers in this part of the country.Deva also demonstrated his versatility through his association with Kamal Haasan, composing for films such as Avvai Shanmugi, which showcased a different musical sensibility from the larger-than-life hero themes he created for Rajinikanth.Born Devanesan Chokkalingam on Nov 20, 1950, in Mylapore, he came to film music after working in television and stage shows. His early musical exposure included classical training under Dhanraj, Western musical studies and stage performances. He worked at Doordarshan's Podhigai channel and composed songs for the farming programme Vayalum Vaazhvum. While his brothers, Sabesh and Murali, were also in the music business, his son, Srikanth Deva, is a composer too.Deva made his debut in 1989 with Manasukketha Maharaasaa. Prashanth's Vaikasi Porandhaachu in 1990 gave him his big break, establishing his ability to deliver accessible and emotionally engaging music.His other hits included Aasai, Kaadhal Kottai, Naerukku Ner, Vaali, Avvai Shanmugi, Kushi and Panchathanthiram. He worked in Tamil, Telugu and Malayalam, and his scores run to more than 400 films.Despite his success, Deva remained known for his humility and appreciation of fellow musicians. He spoke admiringly of Ilaiyaraaja and Rahman and welcomed the work of younger composers, maintaining a reputation for simplicity both in his music and in his personal demeanour.Members of the film industry posted messages in memory of Deva.You Can Also Check: Gold Rate in Chennai | Silver Rate in Chennai | Bank Holidays in Chennai | Public Holidays in Chennai | Chennai AQI | Weather in Chennai | Petrol Price in Chennai | Diesel Price in Chennai | CNG Price in Chennai | LPG Price in ChennaiStay updated with the latest Chennai news.
